messages.english: Export saved field layouts for Google Earth.
messages.translation: Bvisani mbumbo dza masimu dzo vhulungwaho dza Google Earth.
Design Studio → U lima → Zwipida zwa masimu

messages.english: Choose one field or all fields, then download the saved boundaries, beds and path lines as KML. Labels are optional; map-reference locations are not surveyed boundaries.
messages.translation: Nangani tsimu nthihi kana masimu othe, nahone ni kope mikano yo vhulungwaho, mmbete ya u ṱavha (beds) na mitalo ya dzinḓila sa KML. Zwiga a si zwa khombe-khombe; fhethu ha ndaedzo ya mmapa a si mikano yo pimiwaho nga u ela mavu (survey).
